messages.author: bc43749aff740d5b
messages.subject: wrapper for Edward
parts:
Hello!

I've been using Stan for a little bit, and just discovered Edward. (First, I must say, your work is amazing; it's really helping me to prototype graphical bayesian models in an easily testable way, I really appreciate it).
I know this isn't the right place to ask about Edward, but I wasn't sure what was.
My question: Is there anyway to specify model_code using Stan, or save a model using Stan, and then input it to the Edward pipeline to leverage its substantial speed increase etc?

Thanks!
Ben

messages.author: bc43749aff740d5b
messages.subject: Re: wrapper for Edward
parts: Answered my own question: http://edwardlib.org/api/model-wrappers

messages.author: a5e83218c834e013
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Re: wrapper for Edward
parts:
To be clear, do not expect anything close to the speedups claimed
in the Edward paper.  They are very misleading and will disintegrate
when you try to build the kinds of nontrivial models for which Stan is
targeted.
